craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of becoming; vyabhicāri utsāha at triple-becoming prayed. Sanskrit-first: samadhiśayitum (OVERLAY per UNC — kept; lays-over, not covers); tridhā (TRIPLE — kept; doing/knowing/willing). Rows: 9 (doing/knowing/willing triple — prayed triple), 1 (‘eager to overlay’ closes — heart's eagerness last). Close: ‘heart eager to overlay’. Rupture: period (shown turns to prayed — He shows, then I pray). Rejected: ‘cover’ for overlay — killed: overlay lays-over; ‘threefold’ smoothing — killed: triple-named kept. Read aloud: YOU-swell SE-quence ON-that-GROUND, METE your-POW-ers' DIFF-er-ence — … THEN-triple-NAMED — DO-ing, KNOW-ing, WILL-ing, MAY-i be-COME-triple, HEART-ea-ger TO-o-ver-LAY.

lines: You swell sequence on that ground, mete Your powers' difference —
show always in Yourself, O god. Then triple-named — doing, knowing, willing, may I become triple, heart eager to overlay.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kramollāsaṃ tasyāṃ bhuvi viracayan | trirūpaṃ bhūyāsaṃ samadhiśayituṃ vyagrahṛdayaḥ

reads_against.argmap: How become triple-formed? → He swells and shows; prayer to become triple for overlaying.
c1_essence: Swelled sequence shown; triple-becoming prayed for overlaying.
